description.value: Healthy Noodle House is a small, owner-operated noodle shop in Kitsilano on the popular West 4th cycling corridor, offering fully customizable noodle soups built from fresh vegetables, scratch-made broths, and no MSG or heavy additives. Featured in both the Vancouver Sun and the Georgia Straight, it has earned a loyal local following for its health-conscious take on Asian comfort food. The owner, Colin, is known for friendly, personal service — including greeting customers by name — and also sells house-made chili sauce and frozen dumplings to take home.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates all OSM contact details (address, phone, email). Takeout is confirmed by explicit pick-up references on the website; vegetarian and vegan options are confirmed by menu items including vegan meat substitutes, tofu, and vegetable-only noodle builds. Bike parking, water refill, and washrooms are not mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, leaving all three required criteria as null.
concerns: OSM opening_hours lists Monday as an operating day, but the website footer and hours section enumerate only Tuesday through Sunday — possible discrepancy in operating days that should be verified before publishing.
